name: minemodcraft
description: Minecraft Mod/Addon ビジュアル開発スタジオ
author: CUBICENGINEstudio

scripts.build:sprout:win: cross-env MMC_EDITION=sprout MMC_EDITION_UPPER=SPROUT next build && cross-env MMC_EDITION=sprout MMC_EDITION_UPPER=SPROUT electron-builder --win --config.appId=com.cubicengine.sprout --config.extraMetadata.mmcEdition=sprout
scripts.build:sprout:mac: cross-env MMC_EDITION=sprout MMC_EDITION_UPPER=SPROUT next build && cross-env MMC_EDITION=sprout MMC_EDITION_UPPER=SPROUT electron-builder --mac --config.appId=com.cubicengine.sprout --config.extraMetadata.mmcEdition=sprout
scripts.build:grove:win: cross-env MMC_EDITION=grove MMC_EDITION_UPPER=GROVE next build && cross-env MMC_EDITION=grove MMC_EDITION_UPPER=GROVE electron-builder --win --config.appId=com.cubicengine.grove --config.extraMetadata.mmcEdition=grove
scripts.build:grove:mac: cross-env MMC_EDITION=grove MMC_EDITION_UPPER=GROVE next build && cross-env MMC_EDITION=grove MMC_EDITION_UPPER=GROVE electron-builder --mac --config.appId=com.cubicengine.grove --config.extraMetadata.mmcEdition=grove
scripts.build:all:win: npm run build:sprout:win && npm run build:grove:win
scripts.build:all:mac: npm run build:sprout:mac && npm run build:grove:mac
scripts.build:all: npm run build:all:win && npm run build:all:mac
scripts.android:build: cross-env MMC_TARGET=android next build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:build && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:build && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.ios:build: cross-env MMC_TARGET=android next build && cap sync ios
